subjects.displayTitle: Prayer for steadfastness: love, obedience and enduring service
subjects.introduction: Steadfastness, as Bahá’u’lláh and ‘Abdu’l-Bahá teach it in prayer, is never claimed as a personal achievement. It is asked for. The heart cannot find tranquillity, one prayer confesses, except through divine loving-kindness; the servant who testifies to God’s oneness admits that doubt still seizes him at times; a broken-winged bird asks to be made firm. To pray for constancy is to accept that love must be renewed, and that the renewal comes from beyond oneself. Yet the asking never rests in the heart alone. Firmness is meant to show itself in trustworthiness, forgiveness, wise speech and virtuous deeds, in a service that reaches as far as reconciliation among peoples. The images change with the need: a cord to hold, a sheltering tree, living water for a thirsty soul, the fortified stronghold of the Covenant. Prisoners, widows and whole families are prayed for by name, and prosperity is named as a test no less than adversity. From here the journey leads into the wider life of prayer, and into steadfastness and perseverance as the daily shape that faithfulness takes.

We beseech Thee to grant us steadfastness in Thy Cause and firmness and constancy in Thy Mighty Message, whereby the limbs of the nations have trembled and the pillars of the world have quaked, save those rescued by the hand of Thy grace and the arm of Thy power.

I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy utterance and the effulgences of the Orb of Thy proof to number me with such as were not held back by swords from drawing nigh unto Thee, nor by cannons from turning toward the lights of Thy countenance.

O Lord! Leave us not to ourselves. Take the hands of Thy servants with the hands of Thy power, then preserve them from Thine enemies.

Make their hearts steadfast in Thy love amidst humanity, illumine their eyes with witnessing Thy effulgent lights from the highest horizon, perpetuate these blessings upon them, and deprive them not of that which Thou hast ordained for pure souls, the angels of the exalted sphere.

Glorified art Thou, O my God!

I beseech Thee by the tears of the sincere ones and the sighs of them that are nigh unto Thee in their separation from Thee, to aid me to stand firm with such steadfastness as cannot be shaken by the doubts of the doubters nor the cawing of the crows, and to enable me to serve Thy Cause with wisdom and utterance.

"My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Countenance, and the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge, and the mysteries of Thy Book, to aid me in all conditions to serve Thee and to serve Thy loved ones.

I beseech Thee to assist us in that which Thou hast commanded us outwardly in Thy Book; then ordain for us what befitteth our relationship to Thee.

order.why: Place personal constancy within the language of covenant, shared responsibility, faithful remembrance and prayer for others.

order.why: Place personal constancy within the language of covenant, shared responsibility, faithful remembrance and prayer for others.
shortened: Say: Glory be unto Thee, O God of existence and Lord of the seen and unseen! I beseech Thee by the Word whereby Thou hast distinguished between Thy loved ones and Thine enemies, to make me steadfast in Thy love and speaking in Thy praise.

order.why: Place personal constancy within the language of covenant, shared responsibility, faithful remembrance and prayer for others.

I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the rains were caused to fall and the seas to surge and the trees to speak, that Thou assist me to be steadfast in this Cause which, when it was revealed, caused feet to slip.

order.why: Place personal constancy within the language of covenant, shared responsibility, faithful remembrance and prayer for others.
shortened: Say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God and the God of all, the Sender of the Messengers and the Revealer of the Books! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance that Thou disappoint me not from steadfastness and from that which is with Thee.

order.why: Place personal constancy within the language of covenant, shared responsibility, faithful remembrance and prayer for others.
shortened: O my God! Illumine the eyes of hearts with the light of Thy countenance, O Beloved, then make them steadfast in Thy Cause - verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Forgiving - and firm in such wise that the cawing of those who claim what hath not been ordained for them in the Book will not disturb them.

I beseech Thee by Thy Name, and by Thy Cause, and by Thy might, and by Thy power, and by Thy sovereignty, and by Thy greatness, and by Thy dominion, and by Thy majesty, that Thou aid me to remain steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise that neither the oppression of the wicked ones nor the clamor of the enemies shall hold me back.

I beseech Thee by the outpourings of Thy days and the fragrances of Thy utterance, and by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the kingdom of earth and heaven, to make me steadfast in Thy love and content with whatsoever hath flowed from the Pen of Thy decree. Enable me, O my God, to serve Thy Cause, then write down for me through Thy bounty and grace that which shall profit me.

I beseech Thee not to deprive her, through Thy grace and favor, of that which she seeketh, for through Thy loving-kindness I have recognized the greatness and sovereignty of Thy Cause. O my Lord! I am Thy weak handmaiden who hath sought refuge in Thee, and Thou art the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.

Say: My God! I beseech Thee by Thy signs and Thy clear tokens to make me in all conditions hold fast unto Thee and gaze toward Thy horizon.

Pour out upon me patience in this tribulation, make firm my footsteps upon Thy path, illumine my countenance with the light that hath shone forth from the Dayspring of Thy mercy, give me to drink from the cup that overfloweth with the water of Thy grace, kindle within my heart the fire of Thy love, and occupy me with Thy remembrance until I forget all else but Thee and turn my face toward Thy gracious countenance.

Rather, whenever the fires of torment blazed fiercer, they found them as sweet water in Thy path, and whenever the winds of tests blew more severely, they increased in steadfastness and firmness in Thy Cause.

Verily thy Lord is the True One, the Faithful. They that have wronged thee and commanded thy imprisonment - these have no portion in the Book of God, the Possessor of this luminous Day. Thou hast attained unto that which none hath attained except whom God, thy Lord, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate, hath willed.

shortened: O Lord! Make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love in such wise that tribulations may not prevent me from turning toward Thy direction, O Thou in Whose hand are the names.

shortened: I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that neither the hosts nor the ranks nor the tyrants and Pharaohs of the earth shall prevent me.

I beseech Thee not to withhold from me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, whom neither the swords of the enemies could prevent from turning to Thy Most Exalted Horizon, nor the clamor of the divines from Thy mention, O Thou Who art the King of earth and heaven, and Lord of the Hereafter and of the former days.

I beseech Thee by Thy sovereignty that hath subdued the names, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, and speaking in Thy praise, and arising to serve Thy loved ones. Then open before my face the door of Thy mercy.

I beseech Thee by the cries of those near unto Thee in their separation from Thee, and the lamentations of the sincere ones in Thy days, and by the ocean of Thy verses and the dawning-place of Thy revelation and inspiration, to strengthen me in such steadfastness as shall not be shaken by the hosts of the heedless nor the ranks of the oppressors.

shortened: O my Lord! Thou knowest that I have turned towards Thee and hastened to the place wherein He Who is the Manifestation of Thy Self, the Dawning-Place of Thy verses and the Dayspring of Thy evidences was imprisoned.

I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Ultimate Hope of the sincere ones and the Beloved of the hearts of the lovers, to aid me in serving Thee and in promoting Thy Cause amongst Thy servants and creatures, and to make me one of those who have partaken of the wine of steadfastness and assurance and have attained unto that which Thou didst desire for them, O Thou Who art the Lord of Religions and the Creator of the worlds.

shortened: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the mysteries of the ocean of Thy knowledge to confirm me in such steadfastness as shall not be prevented by the doubts of the learned nor the signs of the divines nor the power of rulers.

order.why: Read the language of endurance in its settings of imprisonment, loss and persecution; keep its petitions, consolation and voluntary devotion together.
shortened: O my God, my God! The Wronged One makes mention of Thee before Thy chosen ones and Thy loved ones, and beseeches Thee by the power of Thy Most Exalted Pen, whereby Thou hast subdued the kingdom of names and all who dwell in the realm of creation, to aid us to remain steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise as to make the limbs of them that raise the cry of denial among Thine enemies to quake--they who have cast the Book of God behind their backs, clinging to their own idle fancies and vain imaginings.

order.why: Read the language of endurance in its settings of imprisonment, loss and persecution; keep its petitions, consolation and voluntary devotion together.
shortened: O my Lord! Make me steadfast, then, in Thy love and establish me in Thy Cause in such wise that should Thy servants who are veiled by learning from Thy Self-Subsisting Name oppose me, their opposition to Thee and their turning away from Thee would not disturb me.

shortened: O Lord! I beseech Thee by the imprisonment of Him Who is the Manifestation of Thy signs, and by His exile and sorrow and tribulation, to bestow through Thy bounty upon all who have been tried in Thy name that which shall make them steadfast in Thy Cause and abiding through the perpetuity of Thy kingdom and dominion.

shortened: I beseech Thee, O King of Kings and Merciful Lord of all who are possessed, by Thy Command through which Thou hast subdued the kingdom of earth and heaven, to assist them to achieve the Most Great Steadfastness, whereby nothing in all the world of creation shall prevent them from drawing nigh unto Thee.

Rather, I beseech You with all humility and supplication: Increase, O my God, my tribulation in Your path, and ordain for me every affliction in Your love, and let me drink the cup of the greatest adversity, and taste the honey of the supreme ordeal, and cast me into the darkest prisons under chains and fetters out of love for Your beauty, passion for Your countenance and desire for Your good-pleasure.

Make him self-sacrificing! Make him homeless, and without rest! Fill his heart with Thy love, so he will forget all else save Thee,--seeking no other comfort, grace, health or life, and sacrificing all for Thee!"

shortened: I beseech Thee, O Beloved of the worlds and Lord of the nations, by Thy Name through which the spirit of life was breathed into all possibility, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise that the imaginings of the idolaters among Thy creatures shall not hinder me.

shortened: Beseech thou God to make thee steadfast in that wherein thou art, for this is a station greater than every station and mightier than every mighty thing.

shortened: Say: My God, my God! I have turned toward Thee, holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty and clinging to the hem of Thy generosity. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy bestowals and by the Dawning-places of Thy revelation and inspiration, to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause.

shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the kingdom of Thy beauty and the dominion of Thy glory, and by Thy power before the manifestation of which the people of Thy realm and Thy dominion have bowed down, to ordain for me that which shall make me steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love, standing in Thy service, and acting according to that which Thou hast commanded me in Thy Book.

order.why: Read the language of endurance in its settings of imprisonment, loss and persecution; keep its petitions, consolation and voluntary devotion together.

I beseech Thee, O Thou Who controlleth the winds and Who causeth the dawn to break, by Thy command through which Thou didst open the gates of bounty unto all nations, to assist me to serve Thy Cause in such wise that nothing whatsoever may prevent me, O Thou Lord of all beings and Sovereign of the kingdom of names.

order.why: Near the close, consider why both prosperity and adversity can call for renewed reliance and care.
shortened: Then inspire them, O my God, with that which will cause them to hold fast in adversity and prosperity unto the cord of Thy loving care and to cling to the hem of the robe of Thy bounty. Verily Thou art the Omnipotent, the Most Great, the All-Compelling, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Praise be unto Thee, for verily Thou art the Mighty, the Great.

order.why: Conclude the linked readings by connecting perseverance in adversity and prosperity with humble trust, enduring love and service throughout the remaining days.
shortened: O my God and my Lord! I beseech Thee by the heaven of Thy Will and the ocean of Thy Purpose to make me in all conditions turned towards Thee and steadfast in Thy love.

order.why: Let the admission of not knowing what is beneficial lead into trust, wisdom and continued action.
shortened: Ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which will assist me to remain steadfast in Thy Cause and to mention Thee among Thy servants with wisdom and utterance. O my Lord! Thou seest Thy servant clinging to the cord of Thy grace and holding fast to the hem of Thy mercy. Ordain for him every good that was in Thy Book.

order.why: Bring the linked sequence toward its close with service throughout the days that remain.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee for having guided me to the horizon of Thy Cause after Thy servants were barred therefrom, and for having admitted me into the pavilion of Thy nearness and honored me with Thy presence after the forces of the heedless had seized the prison gate. O my Lord! Aid me to serve Thee throughout my remaining days. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

shortened: When thou hearest the call from the Most Exalted Horizon, say:

My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having awakened me through the breathings of Thy Revelation, made known to me Thy ancient bounty, and shown me Thy wondrous generosity. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the signs of Thy grandeur, and by Thy Prophets and Messengers whom neither the might of the oppressors deterred from drawing nigh unto Thee, nor the tyranny of the Pharaohs from turning toward the light of Thy countenance,
to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love.

questions: What changes when steadfastness is approached as something for which a person prays? How do the admissions of doubt, weakness and limited understanding affect your reading of the calls to remain firm?

How do the prayers connect obedience with understanding, love and virtuous deeds? What might trustworthiness, forgiveness, fairness and the rejection of bloodshed reveal about the kind of firmness the collection seeks?

What do the images of a cord, a sheltering tree, a thirsty soul, a broken-winged bird and a heart illumined by knowledge each disclose about dependence and growth? Which image speaks most clearly to a difficulty you have encountered?

How do the texts hold together the wish for protection from suffering and the willingness to remain faithful through it? What can the Gethsemane narrative contribute to this inquiry, while its particular setting and the different speakers in this collection remain in view?

What happens to personal perseverance when it becomes prayer for another person, mutual encouragement or service to peace? How can a community sustain conviction while practicing the kindness, wisdom and freedom from backbiting described here?

Why might prosperity as well as adversity call for steadfastness? How could the prayers here and Psalm 119 help connect daily attention with lasting purpose, and what would you explore next in the connected subjects on prayer and perseverance?

references.label: 1 · Psalm 119:33–40 · Understanding, desire and faithful action
references.note: Read these verses in the King James Version, attending to the psalmist’s requests to be taught, to understand, and to have the heart and eyes directed toward what gives life. Obedience here involves attention and desire as well as outward action; the speaker seeks delight in the path and release from covetousness and vanity. Compare this prayer with the petitions for illumined understanding, virtuous deeds and constancy in this guide. How does asking for help change the meaning of an undertaking to remain faithful? What relationship emerges between learning a commandment and coming to love its practice? Keep the psalm’s devotion to God’s law in its biblical setting alongside the Bahá’í prayers addressed within a particular history of revelation.

references.label: 2 · Matthew 26:36–46 · Prayer in a time of sorrow
references.note: Read the Gethsemane passage in the King James Version. Notice Jesus’ sorrow, His repeated prayer concerning the cup and the Father’s will, and the disciples’ difficulty staying awake. The scene brings the desire for relief into the same prayer as consent to a demanding divine purpose. Set it beside the guide’s petitions for protection, patience, strength and alignment with God’s will. What does it suggest about the place of vulnerability within faithfulness? How might the instruction to watch and pray illuminate the need to renew a commitment repeatedly? Attend to the differences between Jesus’ approaching betrayal in Matthew’s narrative and the particular experiences of imprisonment, loss and service described in the Bahá’í texts.
